name: World orchestra
summary: The world's musical regions on one map, each with its own recorded instrument. Click or use the arrow keys to hear a region; turn Instruments off and press Play to hear cities play the data.
author: moran
description: The world's musical regions on one map. Instruments (on at first): click, tap, or use the arrow keys, and each region plays a short phrase on a recorded instrument (djembe, kora, oud, balalaika, khomus, morin khuur, sitar, koto, pan flute...); moving the mouse into a region plays it too. Turn it off and about 280 cities play the data you pick in the Data menu (ozone, carbon monoxide, nitrogen oxides or rain): a city whose value rises past a threshold plays one note in its region's voice.
